subject.title: bug: Duplicate messages sent to Slack

question: Should this stay open until a maintainer/operator correlates the named Slack session with gateway logs and Slack message IDs, or is adjacent duplicate-guard evidence enough to close it?
rationale: The code shows several plausible guards, but choosing an implemented-on-main close without matching the named delivery event would be speculation.

options.title: Keep open pending log correlation

options.title: Close only with matched proof

recommendation.title: Keep open pending log correlation
